about.title: I learn by building systems I can explain.
about.p1: I am Mobina Safarirad, a developer interested in AI engineering, machine learning, and software. I care about how programs are structured, how a model’s output is actually used, and what a result does not mean.
about.p2: I like going deep on a technical problem until the moving parts are clear. I build projects to learn — not to collect a stack of logos. Python, data structures, and Git are where most of my hours go; web engineering is something I am practicing in public with this site.
about.p3: Outside the editor, I read around science, psychology, technology, and human behavior. Those interests are curiosity, not credentials.
